title: Back Office Maps, Elevance Health
sub: Two new Sales Navigator maps for one customer: the people who run claims, enrollment, provider and shared-services operations at Elevance Health, and the people who run operations at Carelon. Nobody from the existing relationship map; every name checked against Salesforce and live-verified.
legend_html: In Salesforce: Intradiem already has a record for this person; they stay on the map because they run part of the back office. Same name elsewhere in Salesforce: a record with this name exists at another company.
md_title: # Back-office map build sheets, Alex's Elevance Health
md_intro: Each sheet is one new Sales Navigator Relationship Map (cap 30). Build top-down: senior executive, then the SVP/VP who leads each function, then the directors under them. Reporting lines are inferred from titles and functions until Alex confirms. Carelon is its own LinkedIn company page, so it gets its own map.

account_notes.Elevance Health: Health Benefits operations consolidated under Felicia Norwood on Feb 26 2026; the two Staff VPs of Operations and Execution in Health Benefits Operations (Keating, Talnose) started in that seat in June 2026, and their manager between them and Norwood is not visible in the data, so both sit under her until Alex confirms. Government Business (Medicaid, Medicare) runs under Aimée Dailey since Mar 31 2026; state Medicaid and Medicare operations directors belong to her division and report to plan COOs, not to the Government customer-care line on the relationship map. Claims runs under Blake Main, Chief Claims Officer, with Chris Thomas as Staff VP Claims Operations. Workforce Management directors surfaced by the search were held to the bench because they are most likely the contact-center WFM team under Jennifer Wade and Brian Altig on the relationship map; the enterprise seat kept is Strategic Workforce Planning. Ratnakar Lavu, EVP and Chief Digital and Information Officer, owns the AI roadmap that includes claims-processing automation (Fortune, Feb 25 2026): not a card, but the in-house automation program the Back Office Optimizer conversation will meet. Two people are current but carry initials-only LinkedIn names and could not be linked: Richard (Rick) Misch, Staff VP Finance Operations / Commercial Billing and Collection Services, and Amber Kanady, Staff VP Payment Integrity Financial Operations (her profile sits under the separate 'Elevance Health (Formerly Anthem)' company page); search both by name in Sales Navigator. Chris Thomas (Staff VP Claims Operations) left in 2024 and Lee Napier has retired, both removed after the live check. The Staff VP of Claims Operations seat has been vacant since Chris Thomas left in 2024, so the claims directors sit directly under the Chief Claims Officer; likewise the Government Business directors sit under Aimée Dailey until their VP layer is confirmed. Alex's own relationship map has four cards to refresh: Maurice Pardo has left, and Amish Patel (GuideWell), Kumar Gudavalli (SCAN) and Che Thompson (Hyundai) show other employers. Salesforce holds Elevance as eighteen plan-level accounts (Amerigroup, Anthem BCBS state plans, Empire, UniCare, Carelon Health, Beacon, IngenioRx) with 303 known people and no parent Elevance or Anthem Inc record, which is why the account plan found no contract record; the customer status comes from the install base.
account_notes.Carelon: Carelon reports to Mark Kaye (EVP and CFO) since Feb 26 2026 after Peter Haytaian's exit; Will Feest is President of Carelon Insights and COO of Carelon (Mar 31 2026). Darrell Oliveira became CFO of Carelon the same day (budget owner, kept off the map as a finance seat); Kristy Duffey is President of Carelon Health (clinical delivery, not the back office) and William Fleming is Chief Growth and Strategy Officer (commercial line). Many Carelon Behavioral Health people still list Beacon Health Options; those cards were live-checked. CarelonRx PBM operations (Sandra T.) is the pharmacy claims back office. Lisa Laplante (VP Claims) and Terry Billyard (AVP Claims Operations Support) surfaced in the search but could not be linked to a live profile, so the claims directors sit under the Carelon Behavioral Health COO until Alex confirms; search both by name in Sales Navigator.
